sources.document_title: PESD24VS1UB — ESD protection diode in SOD523 package
sources.locator: Table 1 Quick reference data (printed page 1), Table 2 Pinning information (printed page 2), Table 5 Limiting values (printed page 3), and Table 6 Characteristics rows VRWM/VBR/IRM/Cd/VCL (printed page 4)
sources.evidence_extract: Official Nexperia product data sheet retrieved from assets.nexperia.com (release 6 August 2026). Table 6 Characteristics at Tamb=25 C: VRWM 24 V max; VBR 26.5/27/27.5 V min/typ/max at IR 5 mA; IRM 1 nA typ / 50 nA max at VRWM 24 V; Cd 23 pF typ / 50 pF max at f=1 MHz, VR=0 V; VCL 36 V max at IPPM 1 A and 70 V max at IPPM 3 A (non-repetitive 8/20 us pulse). Table 5 Limiting values: PPPM 160 W and IPPM 3 A at tp=8/20 us; VESD 23 kV IEC 61000-4-2 contact, 10 kV HBM; Tj max 150 C. Table 2: pin 1 = K cathode (marking bar indicates pin 1), pin 2 = A anode; package SC-79 (SOD523). The LCSC-hosted alternate is the older 29 November 2018 revision of the same Nexperia document.
